title: Piercing Statue Solo #206 (쓰리쿼터 · P50 정의형 · 몸통 3조각 · 왼팔 목재(wenge) · 오른팔 석재(jade) · 몸통 [세로 3등분] 내용물(자수정+수정 조각) / 투명(사파이어) / 석재(black granite) · 왼허벅지 석재(jade) · 오른허벅지 수조(내용물 물) · 체형 still-visible cinched waist beneath · 트윈테일 · 샴페인블론드 · 메이크업 코갸루 · 금속 은 · 쥬얼리 팔찌·반지·목걸이·헤어 장식 JQ1 · 귀 보이기)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter statue multi-material portrait: real face and neck, and a sculpted body made of different materials — her left arm carved wood, her right arm carved stone, her torso split into three pieces (solid glass holding embedded objects, clear crystal and carved stone), her left thigh carved stone and her right thigh a glass vessel full of water. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her sculpted form comes to an end at her knees, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a bright cheeky grin, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in twin-tail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. Her neck, the hollows above her collarbones and the tops of her shoulders carry the same real living skin as her face: visible pores and fine skin grain, a soft sheen of natural skin oils on the highest planes, faint fine peach-fuzz hairs catching the rim light, gentle tonal variation with a natural warm flush, and the fine natural creases of a real neck — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic. Like any real person she is slightly asymmetrical: a few small natural beauty marks and freckles scattered unevenly, one side of her neck and shoulder very slightly warmer and more freckled than the other.

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick silver septum ring with a smaller silver ring above it and two silver rings through each nostril; a straight silver bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick silver bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a silver Medusa stud above the lips; a big silver hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a silver labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small silver studs along each jaw; a curved row of small silver studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized silver hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine silver chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. All jewelry is real silver, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears a single piece of mixed-metal bracelets and bangles on both wrists; a single piece of mixed-metal rings on her fingers; a single piece of mixed-metal necklaces and chains resting on her neck, collarbones and upper chest; a single piece of mixed-metal hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, sitting on and over the material of her body and her real neck and hair without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Physique: A still-visible cinched waist beneath a full soft chest, wide curving hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, her left arm carved wood, her right arm carved stone, her torso split into three pieces (solid glass holding embedded objects, clear crystal and carved stone), her left thigh carved stone and her right thigh a glass vessel full of water.

Boundary (skin to material, at underarm height): A single straight, horizontal line runs across her body at underarm height, level with both armpits. Real skin above this line — her face, neck, both shoulders, and the very tops of both upper arms. Below this line, completely different materials meet at her body's natural joints (both shoulders, both hips) and at the seams inside the torso, each keeping its own distinct appearance right up to where it touches its neighbour, never blending into it. At the underarm line itself, the material immediately below rises in a small raised step above her skin, casting a crisp shadow. Shards interlock along this line only.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): carved from ONE solid block of dark wenge wood, a deep near-black wood finely striped with narrow gold-tan pinstripes running through it, polished to a hard satin sheen, completely opaque, completely opaque, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same wood, the grain running unbroken through it. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved from ONE solid block of deep green nephrite jade, polished to a soft waxy lustre with faint paler clouding, completely opaque, completely opaque, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same stone. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (underarm line down to where the thighs begin): The torso, from the underarm line down to where the thighs begin, is divided into 3 side-by-side pieces by 2 straight vertical seams, about 43% and 71% of the way across it from the left of the picture to the right. Torso piece 1 (the piece on the left of the picture, left of the first seam): carved from ONE solid block of amethyst crystal, with internal facets and colour zoning, deep violet where thickest and pale lilac at every thin edge, never hollow, never split; suspended deep within it, visible through it like objects frozen inside a single flawless crystal, are dozens of small, jagged clear quartz shards like frozen lightning bolts, each one a brighter, sharper facet than the glass around it, each one fully embedded in the solid material with no cavity and no liquid around it. Light passes through the solid material; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it. Torso piece 2 (the middle piece, between the two seams): solid transparent material, solid deep blue sapphire crystal, with fine silky needle inclusions forming a soft star-like shimmer, near-midnight navy where thickest and pale cornflower at every thin edge, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it. Torso piece 3 (the piece on the right of the picture, right of the second seam): carved from ONE solid block of polished black granite with fine silver flecks and a deep mirror-like sheen, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Left thigh (hip down to its tip, right at the knee, where the leg would bend): carved from ONE solid block of deep green nephrite jade, polished to a soft waxy lustre with faint paler clouding, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface. The left thigh ends in its own smooth, deeply polished rounded tip, finished the way a carved sculpture is finished.

Right thigh (hip down to its tip, right at the knee, where the leg would bend): a sculpted vessel of the same clear glass (unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections, sharp white highlights, tiny trapped bubbles), completely filled to the brim with clear water holding a loose scatter of tiny warm glowing fireflies drifting slowly inside it, mostly open clear water around each one. It curves inward and seals shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip, the water continuing unbroken down to that tip. Light passes through; the backdrop is visibly bent inside it.

Where each material meets its neighbour (left shoulder, right shoulder, left hip, right hip, and every seam inside the torso), the two distinct materials sit flush against each other with a thin, clean seam, deliberate and precise, never jagged, torn or blended — always the finish of a sculpture, each material keeping its own colour, clarity and surface completely separate from the one beside it. Both thighs stay clearly separate all the way down, never merging into a single base, both rounded tips resting side by side on the surface beneath her.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a deep crimson on one side and a warm gold on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle — glowing evenly, marked with a few thin dark vertical lines so the bending of those lines is visible wherever the body is transparent, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, body angled 45 degrees, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right hand gently tucking a lock of hair back behind her right ear so the ear and its piercings show clearly, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so a deep crimson light glances off the left half and a warm gold light glances off the right half — passing straight through the transparent parts (right thigh, torso piece 1, torso piece 2), while only reflecting off the opaque parts (left arm, right arm, left thigh, torso piece 3). A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
